plan.task: Record10 conditional soft-state excursion budget under passive Ohmic hard-path pure loss since prior SET read
plan.return_anchor_scope: Six already used native return anchors plus the same-voltage return partner of the fixed0.975V witness; all occur after outward witness
plan.band_scope: Diagnostic symmetric relative bands on raw RESET and SET read current; not measured uncertainty, noise, or a new scoring gate
plan.table_envelope_scope: Inherited numerical sensitivity, not a newly certified global error bound
plan.gamma_c_source: Exact frozen soft_field_mobility_probe plan value, also used for actual-series state comparison
plan.necessary_excursion: u_return-u_outward >= u(Gamma_return_upper)-u(Gamma_outward_lower); report signed bound, and no positive requirement if nonpositive
plan.inverse_count_definition: Two outward inverses plus seven return inverses in each of two sensitivity scenarios; no direct-spectrum root refinement
plan.inverse_method: Monotone log-current/log-Gamma interpolation within existing frozen negative-polarity table; no table extension or Gamma sweep
plan.actual_series_reference_detail: Use refined_state_u and same-stage JSON plan
plan.input_path_correction: Original reference field accidentally included descriptive text. Failed before any inversion; original script/plan/result/report preserved under pre_reference_path_fix. Only path encoding corrected; same16 problems and physical constants retained
plan.series_comparison: Compare required bare Gamma/u with full actual series-cycle4 SET state range and its maximum-Gamma bare-negative current at the fixed witness voltage. No cross-device initialization or validation claim
plan.broad_gamma_trigger: At least one inferred outward Gamma lower bound exceeds gamma_c or ten times actual-series maximum Gamma

direct_spectrum_check.scope: Check frozen-table inverse currents at selected endpoints; no root refinement, physical fit, or new spectrum selection. Preserve discrepancies exceeding inherited envelope

plan.boundary_policy: Zero outward lower gives no finite u_out upper or positive excursion budget. Outside-table targets are retained unresolved; no extrapolation or clipping. Compare with analytic v/Ron ceiling separately
plan.scope: Pure-loss hard path is an explicit model hypothesis. Background may evolve; Gamma upper from total return current is not an observed soft state. No clocks, species, temperatures, or full-model success inferred

scope: One record10 bounded necessary-budget diagnostic. New physical fits0, ODE0, holdout0; original scoring masks and gates unchanged.
Assumes passive Ohmic a cannot grow after prior SETread. This is a model hypothesis, not an observed fact. Dynamic soft background is permitted.
Gamma inferred from total return current is an upper bound only, never an observed soft state. No assumed50% or90% background fraction.
Delta20% raw-current bands and0.3% table envelope are sensitivity assumptions, not measured noise or a new global numerical certificate.
Positive delta_u lower bounds require sufficient soft weakening only under this model decomposition and fixed spectrum. They do not identify species or prove this decomposition.
Order32/64 checks validate selected numerical amplitudes, not broad-state physical adequacy or full-history prediction.
State change per elapsed time is unknown. Large amplitude/state excursion does not by itself measure a fast or slow physical time constant.
